# Repository-local Vale vocabulary. Tracked in git; `.gitignore` un-ignores this
# one subtree of `.github/styles/`, which `vale sync` otherwise owns.
#
# Add a term here only while its upstream pull request against nolte/vale-style
# is pending. A term useful beyond this repository belongs upstream -- the
# `vocab-drift-audit` skill reports entries that have since been accepted there
# and can be dropped.
#
# Pending upstream (nolte/vale-style), drop once released and the pin is bumped:
#
# gopass: the password store every loader script in scripts/ reads from.
gopass
# tfvars: Terraform's variable-definitions file type (`terraform.tfvars`).
tfvars
# ruleset: GitHub's product term for a branch or tag rule set. The `s?` covers
# the plural, because a vocabulary entry is a whole-word pattern.
[Rr]ulesets?
# Sigstore / keyless / Fulcio: the signing project, its short-lived-identity
# signing mode, and its certificate authority (docs/en/system-image-signing.md).
Sigstore
[Kk]eyless
Fulcio
# bootc: the bootable-container tooling whose policy.json limits keyless use.
bootc
